meta.title: Worlds Hub – Discover music, languages, IT & creativity
meta.description: Discover Music-Worlds, Sprachwelten, IT-Worlds and Slop Urself. Your starting point for four independent worlds.
home.eyebrow: Four worlds. A great place to start.
home.lead1: Tune in. Speak up. Think further.
home.lead2: Discover a place for everything that inspires you –
home.stripRest: Why should your starting point have any?
home.worldsLead: Explore, learn something new and connect.
filter.label: Filter worlds by interest
home.aboutLead: Worlds Hub brings independent projects together. Each has its own character, connected by a shared joy of discovery.
home.step1Body: Choose a world that suits you. Music, languages, IT or creative AI ideas – you decide where to begin.
home.step2Body: Every existing world stays directly accessible. Keep using its own website and account.
home.step3Body: Central sign-in is available as a pilot. Existing project accounts are linked only after ownership is verified.
home.accountTitle: Your worlds. One account in the making.
home.accountBody: Central sign-in is being introduced step by step. Until each project is connected, sign in there as usual. Your content and progress stay in that project.
faq.title: Still curious?
faq.accountQuestion: Do I need an account to get started?
faq.accountAnswer: You can open public project pages directly. Each world explains which features need an account. Central sign-in is initially available in the Hub as a pilot.
faq.existingQuestion: What happens to my existing accounts?
faq.existingAnswer: Your accounts and data stay in their respective projects. You will be able to link accounts after securely proving ownership. Matching email addresses alone are not enough.
faq.musicAnswer: An early public version of Music-Worlds is available. Open it from its project card to try the current version.
faq.hfQuestion: How does Slop Urself connect to AI?
faq.hfAnswer: Real AI video generation requires your own valid Hugging Face connection. Signing in with Worlds does not replace it. Quotas and safety approvals still apply in Slop Urself.
detail.existingBody: Your sign-in, roles and personal data are still managed directly in {name}. A connection to a Worlds account is not yet active.
detail.pendingBody: Music games, song recognition and music learning are planned. Once a public version is available, you will find the direct link here.
projects.music-worlds.description: Discover music, contribute your own song clues and play Guess the Song together. For everything that makes a sound.
projects.music-worlds.title:
Music on your mind.
Play it by ear.
projects.music-worlds.detail: Music-Worlds is available as an early independent platform. Discover music, contribute song clues and play Guess the Song together. More music games and learning features are being developed.
projects.sprachwelten.description: Play with words, discover languages and learn together. A world full of moments of discovery.
projects.sprachwelten.title:
Words connect.
So do worlds.
projects.sprachwelten.detail: Sprachwelten combines language games and learning. Explore idioms, dialects, tongue twisters and more, or practise with personal vocabulary notebooks. Existing accounts and progress stay in Sprachwelten.
projects.it-worlds.description: Understand technology, put your knowledge into practice and progress step by step. All you need is curiosity.
projects.it-worlds.title:
From “Why?”
to “Got it.”
projects.it-worlds.detail: IT-Worlds offers learning materials and interactive exercises about computing. Personal learning progress is managed within the application and remains subject to its own permissions.
projects.slop-urself.description: AI, videos and your creativity. Bring unusual ideas to the screen and explore the possibilities.
projects.slop-urself.title:
Good idea?
Absolutely wild.
projects.slop-urself.detail: Slop Urself combines AI videos and playing together. Real AI generation also requires your personal Hugging Face connection. Website sign-in, HF tokens, quotas, jobs and safety approvals remain separate.
account.title: Your account | Worlds Hub
account.description: Use existing accounts and manage your central Worlds sign-in.
account.signedInBody: You are signed in to Worlds Hub. Project accounts and personal progress are not yet linked.
account.intro: Your shared identity for the four Worlds projects starts here.
account.signInBody: Sign-in, registration, email verification and password recovery are handled securely by the central identity service.
account.pilotBody: Central sign-in is available as a pilot. Existing project accounts are not yet linked and remain available directly in their projects.
account.notReadyBody: You can still use your existing accounts directly in the projects. Creating or linking a central account in the Hub is not available yet.
account.dataBody: Roles, contributions, game records and learning progress stay in their respective applications. Accounts are never merged solely because they share an email address.
logout.title: See you in the next world.
logout.body: You are signed out of Worlds Hub. Sessions in other projects and at the identity service may still be active. Sign out there as well if you are using a shared device.
privacy.intro: The Hub links to independent applications. Each world has its own privacy information.
privacy.localBody: Theme and interface language are saved on your device. The Hub uses no analytics or advertising scripts. When you are signed in, your language choice can also be saved as an account preference.
privacy.authBody: Central sign-in runs as a pilot using Neon Auth, which manages your display name, email address and verification status. The Hub stores no passwords or Hugging Face tokens. Essential protected cookies maintain your sign-in. The Hub session expires after no more than 30 minutes; identity-service and project sessions have separate lifetimes. Login transactions, sessions and temporary abuse-prevention counters are stored on the server and regularly cleaned up. IP addresses are hashed with a secret key for the counters; raw IP addresses are not stored in this database.
privacy.hostingBody: Necessary connection data is sent to the hosting provider when you visit. Project links are ordinary links; project content is not embedded here.
